name: Children And Prayer
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of prayer and spiritual vigilance within the family, as seen in Job's example of interceding for his children to guard against sin (Job 1:5). Children are described as a precious heritage from the Lord, highlighting their value and the responsibility to nurture them in godly ways (Psalms 127:3). The wisdom of Proverbs instructs believers to train children in the fear of the Lord, promising lasting faithfulness and a secure refuge for them (Proverbs 14:26; 22:6). These truths underscore the vital role of prayer and spiritual discipline in raising children who honor God.
